lines.text: In the summer of 1939 Europe had been at peace for twenty years.
On the first of September, German tanks crossed the Polish border.
Britain and France gave Berlin two days to pull them back.
No answer came. The ultimatum ran out at eleven in the morning.
By that evening two empires were at war with Germany.
Six years later, sixty million people were dead.
